question: What event at the moment of bodily death marks the culmination described to the goddess?
premises: The time of body-fall is specified.
The skull is said to be pierced.
inference: At the fall of the body, the piercing of the skull occurs as the culminating event.
uncertainties: The exact yogic referent of kapāla-piercing is context-dependent.
plain_english: O goddess, when the body falls, then the skull is pierced.
